FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing, my friends. Something's missing.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I don't know, Pip. I just feel like something's off. The whole kingdom feels...stale.

JESTER PIPER
Perhaps, Your Majesty, it's time for a change?

KING REGINALD
A change? Ha! I need a revolution!

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king summons his trusted advisor, LORD THOMAS, and his royal architect, MASTER JENKINS.

KING REGINALD
Lords, I have a vision. A vision of a new era for our kingdom. An era of...vaporwave.

LORD THOMAS
(skeptical)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty? But that's not exactly...medieval.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense, Thomas! The principles are the same. We just need to...distill the essence of our kingdom into something more...ethereal.

MASTER JENKINS
(nodding enthusiastically)
I see what you mean, Your Majesty. We can incorporate elements of...neon-lit castles, and...futuristic knights, and...

KING REGINALD
(excitedly)
Exactly! And we'll use the most...avant-garde materials. Glass, steel, and...plastic.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The castle walls are now a gleaming, neon-lit monolith, with a giant, holographic display projecting images of...futuristic landscapes and...alien creatures.

KING REGINALD
(to his court)
Behold, my friends! Our new aesthetic!

The courtiers and knights stare in awe, unsure of what to make of the...vaporwave kingdom.

KING REGINALD
(to Jester Piper)
What do you think, Pip? Does it not...captivate you?

JESTER PIPER
(nervously)
Uh, yes, Your Majesty. It's... quite...something.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is now surrounded by his loyal subjects, all of whom are dressed in...vaporwave-inspired attire.

KING REGINALD
(to his court)
We shall call this new era...the "Regnal Wave".

LORD THOMAS
(sarcastically)
Oh, joy.

MASTER JENKINS
(excitedly)
I've designed a new coat of arms for the kingdom! It features a...glowing, neon-lit crown, and...

KING REGINALD
(interrupting)
Enough, Jenkins! We shall make this kingdom the envy of all the...other realms!

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a...vaporwave utopia. Knights in neon-lit armor ride by, while peasants in futuristic clothing scurry about. The king sits on his throne, surrounded by his loyal subjects, all of whom are...lost in a sea of...neon-lit wonder.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Ah, yes. This is it. This is the...Regnal Wave.

FADE TO BLACK.
